snippet.title: Astral Frontier: Lifeskill and Treasure Chests + New UI/UX | Building my Indie MMORPG - Dev-log #5
snippet.description:
This is the dev-log #5 of my journey to make Astral Frontier Online a real game. 

I've implemented a simple, but functional, lifeskill system with Cooking, Alchemy, Mining, Gathering and Fishing of course.

Additionaly, a Treasure Chest just like Genshin Impact is here! (Not fully shown in this video, but will be in a next one)

The new UI/UX is simple, smooth and comes with 4 different colors: Light (White), Dark (Black), Brown and Halloween (Purple).

Lots of glitches and things yet to be fixed. A Alpha-Test is about to open in August!
